description: This file defines the SecurityAdvisoriesFetcher class in Drupal, responsible for fetching, caching, and processing security advisories related to Drupal core and extensions.

classes.name: SecurityAdvisoriesFetcher
classes.description: A final class providing services to fetch and process security advisories from Drupal.org, including caching and applicability checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies and configuration for fetching security advisories.

methods.name: getSecurityAdvisories
methods.description: Retrieves applicable security advisories, fetching from remote if cache is expired or missing.

methods.name: matchesExistingVersion
methods.description: Checks if a security advisory matches the current project version.

methods.name: getMatchingExtensionInfo
methods.description: Finds extension info matching the security advisory's project name.

methods.name: getProjectExistingVersion
methods.description: Gets the current version of the project affected by the advisory.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines if a security advisory applies to the current site.

methods.name: doRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTPS GET request with optional HTTP fallback, returning the response body.
